title: Theorem 1.1 (Main theorem: induced subgraphs of hypercubes)
statement_scope: For every integer n ≥ 1, every (2^{n−1}+1)-vertex induced subgraph H of the n-dimensional cube Q^n satisfies Δ(H) ≥ √n; the inequality is tight when n is a perfect square.
